newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Novotrade sets issue price at 12 DMK.
newsitem.headline: Novotrade sets issue price at 12 DMK.

text.p: Hungary's Novotrade Rt said on Wednesday the subscription price for new shares in its upcoming rights issue was set at 12 German marks or its forint equivalent a share.

Novotrade shareholders will recieve one new share for every five they hold, Novotrade said in a statement. The share issue will raise the company's issued share capital by 110.86 million forints to 665.14 million from the current 554.28 million.
The new shares, available from April 21, will entitle their holders to a dividend for the whole of 1997, it said.

On Tuesday the National Bank of Hungary set the forint's midday rate against the mark at 104.67 forints. On the Budapest Stock Exchange Novotrade shares closed at 1,105 forints on April 11, the last day they were traded.
In 1996 Novotrade posted a consolidated, unaudited after-tax profit of 381 million forints, equivalent to an earnings per share of 344 forints, the statement said.
